name: eval-agent
description: Embedded AI Agent - 面向嵌入式开发的智能 Agent 工具

scripts.prepare:server: node scripts/embed-skills.mjs && node scripts/prepare-server.mjs && node scripts/copy-canvas-runtime.mjs
scripts.prepare:sidecars: pnpm prepare:server && pnpm prepare:serial && node scripts/prepare-bundle-resources.mjs
scripts.prepare:sidecars:macos-universal: pnpm prepare:server:macos-universal && pnpm prepare:serial:macos-universal && node scripts/prepare-bundle-resources.mjs
scripts.package:macos-arm: pnpm --filter @eval-agent/app tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin --bundles app --config src-tauri/tauri.macos.conf.json
scripts.package:macos-universal: pnpm --filter @eval-agent/app tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin --bundles app --config src-tauri/tauri.macos-universal.conf.json
